seo.title: Games
seo.description: Play and wishlist indie games from Inizh, including Ride Along, Yoi-Yurei, and Space Shooter.

items.title: Ride Along
items.tagline: Buckle up, hit the road, and enjoy the ride.
items.summary: A relaxing car driving game built for cruising through serene landscapes at your own pace.
description: Escape into open highways, scenic coastal roads, and tranquil countryside routes. Ride Along lets you leave the pressure of competitive racing behind and focus purely on smooth physics, soothing soundtracks, and peaceful exploration.
Built for players who want a late-night drive without leaving the house.

cover.alt: Ride Along cover art showing a car on a coastal highway at sunset

features: Dynamic day/night cycle and realistic weather conditions
Radio stations featuring ambient, lofi, and synthwave tracks

minimum.Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360

recommended.Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT

items.title: Yoi-Yurei
items.summary: A 2D Metroidvania with Indian folklore influences and multiplayer elements.
description: What if Indians made a Metroidvania? Yoi-Yurei explores mythic landscapes, tight combat, and interwoven co-op paths.
Details are still under wraps, but the prototype already captures the tone we want: mysterious, fast, and visually striking.

items.title: Space Shooter
items.summary: A simple space shooter that lets you play with friends.
description: Our first playable experiment: a no-frills space shooter with easy and hard modes, plus a local multiplayer option.
It exists to prove we can ship something fun and learn fast.
features: Easy Mode if you are new
Hard Mode if you are a gamer

items.title: Love Games
items.summary: Super-fast love games optimised to play with your life partner.
description: A lighthearted multiplayer experiment with a private chatbot twist. Play mini-games and see how well you know each other.
Made as a fun side project by a team that does not take itself too seriously.
features: Private chatbot but you can talk to only one person forever
